name: Comanches
description: The Comanches were a Harlem-based youth street gang active in the late 1940s and early 1950s, documented alongside the Socialistic Dukes as part of the early wave of New York City juvenile gang activity.

sources.title: Ground Zero – Socialistic Dukes and Comanches Gangs' (Harlem) | New York City Fighting Gangs
